description: Push your published articles to Opedd so they can be licensed to AI buyers (requires OPEDD_PUB_BEARER — your opedd_sk_ publisher key). Send 1–100 articles per call; batch larger back-catalogues into multiple calls. Each article needs title, url, and html_body — everything else is optional (published_at defaults to now). This is the supply-side companion to list_publisher_content: use it to onboard your archive or push new content with no code, straight from your AI assistant.

articles.description: 1–100 articles to push in this call.

canonical_url.description: Canonical URL if different from url.

html_body.description: Full article content, HTML or plain text (required, ≤200,000 chars).

is_paid.description: Whether the article is behind a paywall.

published_at.description: ISO-8601 datetime (e.g. 2026-01-15T09:30:00Z). Defaults to now if omitted.

thumbnail_url.description: https cover-image URL for the catalog.

name: push_content
